grammar.summary: 本课学习表推测的 there is no doubt 与 whether...or。

points.title: There is no doubt that...
points.explanation: 表"毫无疑问"的固定句式：There is no doubt that + 从句。与 no wonder 辨析。

examples.en: There is no doubt that they have saved many lives.
examples.cn: 毫无疑问它们救过很多人。

points.title: whether...or... 选择并列
points.explanation: Whether the porpoise saves men for fun or for kindness, ... 主语从句：无论A还是B，让步兼选择。

examples.en: Whether it is curiosity or kindness, we cannot tell.
examples.cn: 无论出于好奇还是善意，我们无从分辨。
